title: Anti-Aging and Skin Treatments
summary: Anti-aging treatments rejuvenate the skin by reducing wrinkles, fine lines, and signs of aging, promoting a youthful, radiant appearance.

sections.heading: Anti-Ageing and Skin Tightening Treatments
paragraphs: There are many anti-aging and skin-tightening treatments we use in this clinic, each targeting different aspects of aging like wrinkles, sagging skin, loss of elasticity, and uneven skin tone. These treatments range from non-invasive procedures to more intensive options and can help improve skin texture, boost collagen production, and restore a youthful appearance.
Below is a list of the treatments we offer and a minor description. For more information go to the relevant page.
sections.body:
There are many anti-aging and skin-tightening treatments we use in this clinic, each targeting different aspects of aging like wrinkles, sagging skin, loss of elasticity, and uneven skin tone. These treatments range from non-invasive procedures to more intensive options and can help improve skin texture, boost collagen production, and restore a youthful appearance.

Below is a list of the treatments we offer and a minor description. For more information go to the relevant page.

sections.heading: 1. Injectables
paragraphs: Injectables provide a non-invasive, quick solution to wrinkles, volume loss, and sagging. The most common include Botox and dermal fillers.
sections.body: Injectables provide a non-invasive, quick solution to wrinkles, volume loss, and sagging. The most common include Botox and dermal fillers.

sections.heading: Botox (Botulinum Toxin)
paragraphs: How It Works: Botox works by temporarily relaxing the muscles responsible for expression lines (like crow's feet and frown lines), preventing wrinkles from deepening.
Benefits: Smooths out dynamic wrinkles and fine lines, particularly in areas like the forehead, around the eyes, and between the brows.
Duration: Results last around 3 to 4 months, requiring repeat treatments for maintenance.
sections.body:
-  **How It Works:**  Botox works by temporarily relaxing the muscles responsible for expression lines (like crow's feet and frown lines), preventing wrinkles from deepening.

-  **Duration:**  Results last around 3 to 4 months, requiring repeat treatments for maintenance.

sections.heading: Dermal Fillers
paragraphs: How They Work: Fillers add volume to areas like the cheeks, lips, and around the mouth. They can also help reduce wrinkles and lift sagging skin by replenishing lost volume.
Types:
Hyaluronic Acid Fillers: Add immediate volume and hydration.
Collagen Stimulating treatments: Stimulates collagen to gradually restore volume and improve skin quality.
Duration: Results can last from 18 months up to 5 years, depending on the type of filler used.

sections.heading: 2. Laser Treatments
paragraphs: Laser therapies target various skin concerns like wrinkles, uneven tone, pigmentation, and sagging by stimulating collagen production and resurfacing the skin.
sections.body: Laser therapies target various skin concerns like wrinkles, uneven tone, pigmentation, and sagging by stimulating collagen production and resurfacing the skin.

sections.heading: PicoWay Laser Resurfacing
paragraphs: How It Works: PicoWay uses a deep fractionated laser to create micro-injuries deep in the skin, promoting healing and collagen production. It improves fine lines, wrinkles, scars, and pigmentation.
Benefits: Ideal for improving skin texture, treating sun damage, and reducing signs of aging.
Downtime: Minimal downtime (1-2 days of redness) depending on the intensity of the treatment.
Duration: Results last for months to years with maintenance sessions.
sections.body:
-  **How It Works:**  PicoWay uses a deep fractionated laser to create micro-injuries deep in the skin, promoting healing and collagen production. It improves fine lines, wrinkles, scars, and pigmentation.

-  **Downtime:**  Minimal downtime (1-2 days of redness) depending on the intensity of the treatment.

sections.heading: CO2 Laser
paragraphs: How It Works: The CO2 laser is a more aggressive option that removes the outer layer of skin and heats the underlying layers, promoting collagen growth and skin tightening.
Benefits: Great for deeper wrinkles, severe sun damage, and significant skin tightening.
Downtime: Significant downtime (about 1-2 weeks of recovery).
Duration: Long-lasting effects, but the skin will continue to age, so maintenance is required after a few years.

sections.heading: 3. Microneedling and PRP (Vampire Lift)
paragraphs: These treatments stimulate collagen and elastin production, improving skin texture, fine lines, and tightness.
sections.body: These treatments stimulate collagen and elastin production, improving skin texture, fine lines, and tightness.

sections.heading: Microneedling (Collagen Induction Therapy)
paragraphs: How It Works: Microneedling uses tiny needles to create controlled injuries in the skin, which triggers the body's natural healing response, boosting collagen and elastin.
Benefits: Reduces wrinkles, fine lines, and improves skin texture. Can also help with acne scars and enlarged pores.
Downtime: 1-2 days of redness and minor swelling.
Duration: Results build over a few months and last up to 1 year.
sections.body:
-  **How It Works:**  Microneedling uses tiny needles to create controlled injuries in the skin, which triggers the body's natural healing response, boosting collagen and elastin.
-  **Benefits:**  Reduces wrinkles, fine lines, and improves skin texture. Can also help with acne scars and enlarged pores.
-  **Downtime:**  1-2 days of redness and minor swelling.
-  **Duration:**  Results build over a few months and last up to 1 year.

sections.heading: PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) or Vampire Facial
paragraphs: How It Works: PRP involves drawing the patient's blood, processing it to concentrate platelets, and then injecting it or applying it to the skin post-microneedling. The growth factors in the plasma help rejuvenate and repair the skin.
Benefits: Improves skin texture, firmness, and radiance. It can also enhance the results of microneedling.
Downtime: Minimal downtime, with results appearing gradually over several weeks.
Duration: Results can last up to 12-18 months.

sections.heading: 4. Chemical Peels
paragraphs: Chemical peels exfoliate the skin, removing dead skin cells and stimulating new skin growth, which can improve skin tone, texture, and tightness.
sections.body: Chemical peels exfoliate the skin, removing dead skin cells and stimulating new skin growth, which can improve skin tone, texture, and tightness.

sections.heading: Medium to Deep Peels (e.g., TCA Peels)
paragraphs: How They Work: A solution is applied to the skin that causes the outer layers to peel off over several days, revealing fresh, tighter skin beneath.
Benefits: Improves skin texture, reduces wrinkles, and tightens the skin.
Downtime: 5-7 days for medium peels and 1-2 weeks for deep peels.
Duration: Results are long-lasting, though the skin will continue to age.

sections.heading: 5. Skin Tightening Devices
paragraphs: Thread Lifts
How It Works: Threads made of dissolvable sutures are inserted under the skin to lift sagging tissue and stimulate collagen production.
Benefits: Provides an immediate lifting effect, followed by gradual skin tightening as collagen forms around the threads.
Duration: Results last around 12-24 months.
sections.body:
**Thread Lifts** 

-  **How It Works:**  Threads made of dissolvable sutures are inserted under the skin to lift sagging tissue and stimulate collagen production.
-  **Benefits:**  Provides an immediate lifting effect, followed by gradual skin tightening as collagen forms around the threads.
-  **Duration:**  Results last around 12-24 months.
